subject: Record locking (maximum number allowed for a run unit)
notes: §12.4.5.9.4 GR7 (cite.py OK 7)) requires a run-unit maximum of at least 255 and an unsuccessful statement with a status that indicates it; §9.1.13.8 item 3 (cite OK) is '53'. Code: PhysicalFileTable.RunUnitLockMax = 255 (L71); LockRecord (L100-101) and PreflightNewLock (L149-150) check the connector ceiling first (54) then TotalRunUnitLocks() >= 255 (53); self re-lock returns 00 before counting. One PhysicalFileTable per run unit's FileRegistry. unit test CobolFileLockTests.RunUnitLockLimit_256thRunUnitLock_Is53 pins 17x15 locks then 53. No COBOL-level golden reaches 256 locks.
